subject: how a voter's real and fake credentials are registered, activated, used to sign encrypted ballots, then anonymized and tallied

groups.why_chosen: A voter's single public tag anchors two credentials, real and fake, both used to sign otherwise-identical encrypted ballots; only at tally does a verifiable shuffle anonymize tags and ballots so only tag-matched real votes get decrypted and counted.
groups.what_to_learn: parallel real/fake instances of the same box template (Credential, Vote) carried through matching Ledger logs, reunited only at a shuffle step drawn with a crossed-ribbon icon
